description: Rothco’s Lensatic Compass is built with a hard plastic case to protect the main components of the compass wherever you travel. The adjustable luminous marching line, floating luminous dial, and magnifying viewer gives essential, precise readings while you are navigating through the wilderness. Sighting hairline gives this outdoor compass accurate aiming while using the thumb hold for stability.
